items.title: A closed immersion is of finite presentation exactly when its sheaf of ideals is of finite type

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that a closed immersion is of finite presentation exactly when its sheaf of ideals is of finite type (statement lines 4206-4216). The counted proof is short and complete: on an affine chart of the target the immersion is the quotient by an ideal whose tilde is the restriction of the ideal sheaf, finite typeness of the sheaf corresponds to finiteness of that ideal, and finite presentation of the quotient ring is likewise equivalent to finiteness of the ideal, so the two conditions agree chart by chart (proof lines 4218-4227). It is H2: the reductions are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard affine descriptions of closed immersions and finite type modules.
